title: Settlement, Transport & Regional Development Integration
objective: Implement Packet-06 district/settlement/regional built-state resolution bindings; housing/service/public-works capacity projections; road/transit/port/freight/access bindings over World/MCS/GPR owners; PCA-12 aggregate transport/capacity/congestion analysis adapters; community/faction/shared Project bindings; specialization/inter-settlement dependency projections; resident/household/workforce capacity references without owning people/jobs; Economy/ODL market/property/funding references without duplicating economic truth; and MSWI consequence Event adapters.
acceptance: District, settlement and regional built state remain projections over canonical owner identities and Packet-06 resolution bindings.
Housing, services and public-works capacity derive from explicit owner-backed built-environment/capability evidence.
Road, transit, port, freight and access networks remain bindings over World/MCS/GPR owners rather than an MBES transport ledger.
Aggregate transport/capacity/congestion analysis uses PCA-12 only where accepted profiles support it and remains noncanonical.
Community/faction/shared Projects remain references to canonical Project/Faction/Organization owners.
Resident, household and workforce capacity references do not create Character, household, staffing or jobs truth.
Economy/ODL market/property/funding references remain owner truth rather than a duplicate economic ledger.
MSWI consequence Events remain handoffs; MBES does not directly fan out unrelated-domain mutation.
Blocking workflows remain semantic/nonvisual, keyboard-capable and provider-off.
boundaries: Character/MNCS/ODL/DPL/Project retain people, household, workforce, organization, job and schedule truth.
MIB-13/Economy and ODL retain market/property/funding/economic truth.
MSWI retains unrelated-domain systemic consequence propagation.
MBES-20 creates no Settlement, transport, Character, household, workforce, Project, economy or provenance ledger.
MBES-24 remains unauthorized until canonical MBES-20 closeout.
next_action: Await the next owner Continue. That command may governed-start only MBES-20.
